body: BLOCK exact d9172180d112d28b67b3f3bcf0fac7e7f67ac8e3. The lookup binds only unit.id and state, and the anchor check binds only node.ref; the factory then publishes unit.span/unit.text/node.support from caller-supplied objects. Both carrier types allow same-identity copies. In an exact archive I added two executable foils: someUnit.copy(text = different words) with the same id returns Right and publishes the substituted text; someNode.copy(support = another node support) with the same ref returns Right and publishes the substituted source span. alignJVM/test fails exactly those two courts (220 total, 218 pass, 2 fail). This is the false tuple the type doc claims to exclude. Repair must derive unit coordinates and node support from the checked recall and source view that match result.recallChecksum/viewFingerprint (or an equivalently bound witness), rather than accepting caller-supplied carriers and checking only their IDs. Add same-id and same-ref substitution courts in a new commit/candidate.
